name: restrovia-cloud
description: Restrovia Cloud: sync API, owner portal and admin panel for Restrovia POS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @restrovia/shared && npm run build -w @restrovia/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @restrovia/shared && npm run lint -w @restrovia/api && eslint tests
scripts.test: npm run build -w @restrovia/shared && npm run test -w @restrovia/api
